summary: A thin Monday: 8 games researched, 3 kept (all medium confidence): Atalanta v Parma (Atalanta 60.5%, draw 23.5%), Bragantino v Santos (Bragantino 46%, draw 26.5%, Santos without Neymar) and Deportivo v Osasuna (Deportivo 43%, draw 31%). Excluded: Lorient v Brest (Breton derby), Gil Vicente v Vitória (Minho derby), Newcastle v Everton (unexplained 10% price jump, Grealish and Branthwaite doubts), Gençlerbirliği v Alanyaspor (conflicting team news, coin flip), Sassuolo v Fiorentina (lineup sources disagree on Sassuolo's back four and Fagioli, no edge on any leg).

checks.team_news: Atalanta (Sarri) have a long injury list. Out: Hien, Kossounou, Kolasinac, Bellanova, Kristensen, Gaetano, Scamacca, Raspadori and Kessié (Fantacalcio, updated 31/10; Sky; Fantamaster). That leaves the centre of defence in emergency, with Scalvini and Obric. Sarri said Scalvini's return was 'un po' improvvisato visto l'infortunio di Kristensen' (SOS Fanta/PazzidiFanta, 1 Nov). Starting11 lists Scalvini as doubtful, but its list is stale: it has Sulemana out, and Sarri said he brought Sulemana on at Florence. Fantacalcio, Sky and Fantamaster all have Scalvini starting. Parma (Gilardino): Sky reports no absentees. Fantamaster (30 Oct) listed Bernabè as injured, but he started on 28 Oct and Fantacalcio (90%) and Sky have him starting. Diego Carlos is back from suspension. Neither side has anyone suspended.
checks.lineups: Sky: Carnesecchi; Zappacosta, Scalvini, Obric, Bernasconi; Pasalic, Ederson; Zalewski, De Ketelaere, Rowe; Krstovic. Fantacalcio: the same, except Elmas (60%) for Zalewski. Fantamaster: the same, with Elmas or Rowe. The only disagreement is one wide attacking spot. Parma 3-5-2: Daffara in goal in all three (Sky says 'confermato al posto di Corvi'; Fantacalcio 80%). The third centre-back (Drobnic or Diego Carlos) and Romero's strike partner (Touré, Lontani or Frigan) differ between sources.
checks.rotation: Atalanta: they drew 2-2 at Fiorentina on Thu 29 Oct (Serie A). Next is the Conference League at home to Kairat Almaty on Thu 5 Nov, 3 days after this game, then Monza away on Sun 8 Nov. The expected XI has about 3 changes from Florence, mostly forced by injury (Kristensen to Scalvini, Gaetano to Pasalic, Rowe for Elmas or Zalewski). Sarri complained that 'il calendario non ci aiuta' but did not talk about rotating for this game. Starting11 flags rotation as likely. Parma: they drew 0-0 with Udinese on 28 Oct. Next is Bologna at home on Sat 7 Nov, with no European or cup game, and they keep a settled XI.
checks.motivation: Atalanta are 13th with 11 points from 9 games and are winless in 3 Serie A games, so they need the win. Parma are 18th with 5 points, in the relegation zone. Gilardino was appointed on 29 Sep (34 days ago, so outside the 14-day rule) and got his first point last time out. Sarri was appointed on 15 Jun 2026. This is not a derby or a rivalry, and both sides have something to play for.
checks.form: Atalanta, all competitions, last 5: W Pafos 3-1, L at Milan 2-3, L at Ajax 0-2, D Frosinone 4-4, D at Fiorentina 2-2. Home league record 3W 1D 1L (11-8). FotMob xG over 9 league games: 12.9 for, 17.9 against, 8.9 expected points (18th-best). They allowed 26 shots at Fiorentina and 24 against Frosinone (ESPN). Sarri: 'Creiamo poche occasioni'. Parma: 1W 2D 6L (5-15), away 0-4 (2-9). FotMob xG 7.4 for, 15.0 against (worst xPts in the league). Last 4 league games: L at Inter 0-3, L Torino 0-3, L at Lazio 1-2, D Udinese 0-0 (8 shots).
checks.h2h: ESPN, last 4 competitive meetings: Atalanta 4-0 Parma (Jan 2026), Parma 1-1 Atalanta (Aug 2025), Atalanta 2-3 Parma (May 2025), Parma 1-3 Atalanta (Nov 2024). That is 1 draw in 4. Starting11, all-time: 19 meetings, 11 Atalanta wins, 3 draws, 5 Parma wins. Style matchup: Atalanta's leaky, injury-hit defence against Parma's low-scoring, deep 3-5-2.

games.reason: I started from the market, about 0.632 / 0.214 / 0.154 after de-vigging Polymarket, which agrees with Bet365, ADM and Kalshi. I shaded home down about 3 points and the draw up about 2. The reasons: Atalanta's underlying numbers are poor (FotMob xGA 17.9 in 9, expected points 18th-best). Their defensive crisis is severe: Hien, Kossounou, Kolasinac and Kristensen are all out, and Scalvini's return was 'improvised' per Sarri. They are winless in 3 league games and drew the last two. Sarri says they 'create few chances'. They play their third game in 7 days, with a Conference League game on Thursday. DraftKings has drifted from -235 to -205. Parma's attack is the league's weakest (xG 7.4, 2 away goals, 0 away points), which keeps home at about 60% and the away win near the market. There are no exclusion triggers: no recent manager change, no derby, not 5+ changes, no 24h move. Confidence is medium, not high, because of minor source conflicts (Starting11's Scalvini doubt, Fantamaster's Bernabè report, the wide-attacker choice) and Atalanta's 10 absentees.
games.main_risk: An injury-hit Atalanta, with Scalvini and Obric at centre-back and Pasalic in midfield, create too little against Parma's deep 3-5-2. They then concede a set piece or a late goal, as in the 4-4 with Frosinone and the 2-2 at Fiorentina, and draw 1-1. Evidence for this: back-to-back league draws, 26 shots allowed to Fiorentina, Sarri's 'creiamo poche occasioni', and Parma's 0-0 last time out.

checks.team_news: Santos: Neymar is suspended (red card v Bahia, then a 2-game STJD ban). Lance (29/10) says Bragantino is the first game of the ban and the appeal is heard on 5 Nov, after this match. João Schmidt is suspended (3rd yellow). Out injured: Willian Arão, Lucas Veríssimo, Gabriel Brazão, Vinicius Lira. Gonzalo Escobar is doubtful (thigh) and not in any predicted XI. Arthur is back in training and likely on the bench. Bragantino: GK Tiago Volpi and Gabriel return from suspension. Out: Gustavo Marques (pubis), José Hurtado, Rodriguinho, Davi Gomes (sources: Gazeta Esportiva, Tribuna do Sertão, FotMob, SportsGambler, Khelnow).
checks.lineups: Gazeta Esportiva, Metrópoles, Tribuna do Sertão and SportsGambler give the same Bragantino 4-2-3-1: Volpi; Ryan Augusto, Alix Vinícius, Guzmán Rodríguez, Juninho Capixaba; Fabinho, Eric Ramires; Lucas Barbosa, Wallace Yan, Fernando; Sasha. Only Khelnow has Cleiton in goal, apparently copying the last XI, when Volpi was suspended. Santos XI agreed across sources: Diógenes; Rodinei, João Alencar, Luan Peres, Barreal; Gustavo Henrique, Oliva; Bontempo, Coutinho, Everton; Gabigol. One small split: Metrópoles has Gustavinho in place of Gustavo Henrique.
checks.rotation: Neither team has a midweek game. Bragantino: last game W 3-0 v Chapecoense on 28/10, next at Vitória on 19/11. Santos: last game 0-0 v Palmeiras on 28/10, next at Coritiba on 18/11. A FIFA break follows this game. Both went out of the Sudamericana in the May group stage, Bragantino went out of the Copa do Brasil in May, and ESPN lists no further cup ties for Santos. Expected changes: Bragantino about 1 (Volpi back); Santos only the forced ones.
checks.motivation: Santos are 8th on 47 pts and Bragantino 9th on 44, both chasing a 2027 Libertadores place with 5 rounds left after this one. The relegation zone is far away (17th Corinthians, 36). Not treated as a derby: no source calls it a clássico. Gazeta and Tribuna call it a 'confronto/duelo paulista', and Bragantino is not one of the São Paulo big four. Coaches are stable: Vagner Mancini at Bragantino since late 2025, Cuca at Santos for 27 league games in 2026.
checks.form: Bragantino, last 10 league games: W2 D3 L5, goals 14-15 (L 1-2 at SPFC, L 2-3 v Bahia, D 1-1 at Botafogo, L 1-2 at Flamengo, L 0-1 at Atlético-MG, D 1-1 v Mirassol, W 4-2 v Cruzeiro, D 1-1 at Remo, L 0-2 at Palmeiras, W 3-0 v Chapecoense). Season home record 8-3-5, goals 27-17. Santos, last 10: W6 D3 L1, goals 16-11, but only 1 win in the last 4 (D 2-2 Flamengo, L 1-2 at Atlético-MG, W 2-1 at Fluminense, D 1-1 Bahia, D 0-0 Palmeiras). Away 6-4-6, with 5 wins in the last 6 away. Season xG from FotMob: Bragantino xG 52.0 (2nd in the league), xGA 43.9, xGD +8.1 (5th); they have scored 42 from that xG, with the 2nd-most big chances missed (58). Santos xG 48.4, xGA 45.4, xGD +3.0 (11th). League draw rate is 27.4% over 329 games; Santos have drawn 11 of 33. xG for only the last 6-10 games was not available.
checks.h2h: Last 5: Santos 2-0 (May 2026, league), 0-0 (Paulistão Jan 2026), Bragantino 2-2 Santos (Sep 2025), Santos 1-2 Bragantino (Apr 2025), Santos 2-0 (Paulistão 2025). FotMob's 16-game record: Bragantino 4 wins, 7 draws, Santos 5 wins (a 44% draw rate). Santos are unbeaten in the last 3 meetings. Both sides play roughly 50% possession and Santos make the most tackles in the league, so a tight, low-margin game is likely.

Stake and Rainbet both returned 403, so no prices were seen.
checks.models: ValorFinal (data through round 33): 45.3 / 26.9 / 27.9, most likely score 1-1 at 12.5%. Predictiq: 49 / 26 / 24, most likely 1-1 at 12%, xG 1.6-1.4. Statz (search snippet only): 44 / 26 / 30. ClubElo and Forebet are unavailable (no Brazil coverage, and 403). Every model puts the draw at 26-27%, above the market's 23.3%.
checks.venue_weather: Estádio Cícero de Souza Marques (Nabi Abi Chedid), Bragança Paulista, grass, about 12k capacity. Bragantino's normal home ground, and a short road trip of about 150 km for Santos. FotMob forecast: 19°C, cloudy, 24% chance of rain, light wind. Nothing extreme. Referee: Edina Alves Batista.

games.reason: Starting from the market (48.3 / 23.3 / 28.3), I moved the draw up to 26.5%. Every model sits at 26-27% (ValorFinal, Predictiq, Statz), the bookmaker de-vigs give 24.3-25.9%, the league draw rate is 27.4%, Santos have drawn 11 of 33 and 3 of their last 4, and the head-to-head is 7 draws in 16. I trimmed the home side to 46%, towards DraftKings (46.8%) and BetMGM (44.0%). Bragantino's better underlying numbers (xGD +8.1 against +3.0, home record 8-3-5) and Santos missing Neymar and Schmidt stop it going lower. Santos stay at about 27.5%: their away form is strong, but they are without their two best-known absentees. Both legs still clear the threshold: home-or-draw (1X) about 0.725, fair price about 1.38; DNB about 0.626, fair about 1.60.
games.main_risk: A low-scoring draw, most likely 1-1. Bragantino waste chances (2nd-most big chances missed, 42 goals from 52 xG). Santos defend compactly (most tackles in the league), have drawn 3 of their last 4, and are unbeaten in 3 meetings with Bragantino. Both models make 1-1 the most likely score.

checks.team_news: Deportivo out: Aubameyang (knee arthroscopy, target return Alavés on 21 Nov per Comuniate 26 Oct), Zakaria Eddahchouri (hand, 'several weeks' per Hidalgo), Marc Casadó (collarbone), Bright Ede. FotMob and Statszone list the same four. Statszone also has Noe Carrillo questionable, but he is in no predicted XI. Osasuna out: Aimar Oroz (hamstring relapse; elgoldigital 15 Oct says he misses Racing, Sevilla, Deportivo and Athletic, return around 22 Nov), Jorge Herrando and Romain Del Castillo. Comuniate calls all three injured, FotMob has Oroz and Herrando 'doubtful', and no source puts any of them in the XI. Goalkeepers: Leo Román for Deportivo; Aitor Fernández for Osasuna, kept ahead of Sergio Herrera under Arrasate (Comuniate 18 Oct).
checks.lineups: Three sources: Comuniate, Statszone and FotMob/enetpulse. Deportivo 4-2-3-1: Román; Altimira, Giménez, Loureiro, Quagliata; Amatucci + one of Villares/Luismi Cruz; Mella/Luismi, Soriano, Yeremay; Nsongo. Ten of eleven agree; the last midfield/wing slot (Villares, Luismi Cruz or Mella) differs, which is a selection choice, not an injury. Osasuna: Aitor; Rosier, Boyomo, Catena, Bretones; Moncayola, Torró or Iker Muñoz (Comuniate gives Iker Muñoz 50%), Moi Gómez; Rubén García, Budimir, Dubasin (FotMob has Raúl García for Dubasin in a 4-4-2). Agreement is good apart from these one-slot doubts.
checks.rotation: Both played Copa del Rey first-round ties on Thu 29 Oct against lower-league sides (Deportivo won 3-0 at Auriense, Osasuna 6-0 at Atlético Calatayud). Both next play LaLiga on Sat 7 Nov (Deportivo at Espanyol, Osasuna v Athletic). Neither is in Europe. The predicted XIs mirror the last league XIs, so I expect 0–1 changes on each side.
checks.motivation: Deportivo (promoted, 13th, 11 pts) v Osasuna (15th, 11 pts) are level on points and one point above 18th place (Elche/Levante, 10), so both have real stakes. Not a derby or rivalry (Galicia v Navarra). Osasuna sacked Luis Ramis after a 5-2 loss at Betis and appointed Jagoba Arrasate on 12 Oct (presented 13 Oct), 21 days ago and outside the 14-day rule; under him they are W1 L1 in the league plus the cup win. Antonio Hidalgo is established at Deportivo.
checks.form: Deportivo are W2 D5 L3 (GF 13, GA 13), winless in 6 league games (D3 L3): Sevilla 0-1 H, Betis 1-1 H, Real Sociedad 2-3 A, Levante 1-1 H, Atlético 0-1 A. Home W1 D3 L1 (6-5). FotMob xG 11.7 for and 11.7 against in 10 games (about 1.17 each way per game). Osasuna are W3 D2 L5 (GF 10, GA 20): Betis 2-5 A, Racing 2-0 H, Sevilla 0-2 A. Away W1 D0 L4 (6-17), four straight away defeats. FotMob xG 14.9 for and 14.0 against, so they have underperformed badly (xPoints 14.2 v Deportivo's 13.2).
checks.h2h: ESPN last 5: 2021 Copa Deportivo 1-2 Osasuna; 2019 LaLiga2 Osasuna 2-1; 2018 LaLiga2 Deportivo 2-0; 2017 LaLiga Osasuna 2-2; 2016 LaLiga Deportivo 2-0 (one draw in five). Statszone: in La Liga since 1997/98 Deportivo lead W11 D8 L7 (31% draws), are unbeaten in their last 5 home league games v Osasuna (W3 D2) with five clean sheets, and Osasuna have not scored at Riazor since 2007. This is the first top-flight meeting since 2017. Expect a low-event game: Deportivo's attack is weakened, and Under 2.5 is favoured (DraftKings -150).

games.reason: Starting point is the market (44.7/29.7/25.7), which DraftKings (44.1/29.2/26.7) and Bet365 (44.3/29.3/26.4) confirm, with no big 24h move. I shade home down about 1.7 points and the draw up about 1.3. Deportivo are without both senior strikers (Aubameyang, Eddahchouri) and Casadó, have gone 6 league games without a win, have drawn 5 of 10 (3 of 5 at home), and their xG is low both ways (about 1.17 for and against per game), all signs of a draw. Osasuna's underlying xG (14.9 for, xPoints above Deportivo's) is better than their 10-20 goal record. Against that, Osasuna have lost 4 straight away (6-17 away), are missing Oroz, Herrando and Del Castillo, and Deportivo's recent home record against them is strong (W3 D2, five clean sheets), so I keep away near the market. Lineup sources agree apart from single-slot selection doubts, which is why confidence is medium. Fair odds at my p: Deportivo or Draw about 1.35, Deportivo DNB about 1.60, Osasuna or Draw about 1.75.
games.main_risk: A low-scoring draw (0-0 or 1-1). A Deportivo attack without Aubameyang and Eddahchouri struggles to break down an organised Arrasate side, as in their 1-1 home draws with Elche, Betis and Levante. The evidence for this is already in the higher draw figure.

checks.team_news: Newcastle: Jaouen (GK, not the starter) and Livramento (knee) are out. Osula (ankle) is reported differently: Rotowire says doubtful and Jaissle said 'too early', Onside/FPL put him at 50%, and a Shields Gazette headline (page returned 403, so headline only) says he is out for two months. Miley (muscle, 75%) and Fernandez-Pardo (illness, 75%) are doubts. Elanga is back but has limited minutes. Everton: Grealish missed the cup tie for 'a breach of club discipline' (and missed Arsenal with illness). Moyes: 'I'd never give any team news away.' Rotowire lists him out, starting11 has him doubtful but in its XI. Branthwaite is at 75% (concussion protocol); Moyes: 'Jarrad should have recovered'. Mykolenko is flagged doubtful but played 86 minutes on Thursday. Norgaard has a groin injury.
checks.lineups: starting11, Rotowire and thefalse9 agree on the core of both sides. Newcastle: Hornicek in goal, Dedic, Burn, Hall, Gonzalez, Barnes, Wissa. Everton: Pickford, Tarkowski, Branthwaite, Mykolenko, Garner, Dewsbury-Hall, George, Barry. They differ on Newcastle's second centre-back (Thiaw or Schar), the midfield pair (Willock or Joelinton) and the winger (Murphy or Elanga). For Everton they differ on right-back (Rohl or Maitland-Niles), whether Grealish starts, and Armstrong or Hackney.
checks.rotation: Newcastle are not in Europe this season (finished 12th last season, per The National), so there is no Champions League midweek. Both teams last played each other on Thu 29 Oct: Everton won the Carabao Cup R16 3-1, and Newcastle made only one change to start (club match report). Next games: Newcastle at Fulham on Sat 7 Nov; Everton at home to Coventry on Fri 6 Nov, a short turnaround. Both should make only 1-3 changes.
checks.motivation: Newcastle are on 11 points (12th per thefalse9) and Everton on 10 (14th), so both sides are mid-table with something to play for. Newcastle have a revenge angle after the cup exit four days ago. This is not a derby. Jaissle was appointed in August 2026 and Moyes remains Everton manager, so neither change falls in the last 14 days.
checks.form: Newcastle in the league (ESPN): drew Liverpool 2-2 at home, won 2-0 at Spurs, drew Bournemouth 2-2 at home, lost 4-1 at Leeds, beat Hull 2-1 at home, lost 4-1 at Coventry, lost 0-1 at home to Villa, won 2-0 at Palace. That is 3W 2D 3L, goals 12-14, and at home 1W 2D 1L. Everton in the league: won 2-0 at home to Palace, drew 1-1 at Bournemouth, drew 2-2 at home to Man Utd, drew 0-0 at Spurs, beat Ipswich 1-0 at home, drew 2-2 at Hull, lost 0-2 at home to Chelsea, lost 2-0 at Arsenal. That is 2W 4D 2L, goals 8-9, and away 0W 3D 1L. Onside's xG-based ranks: Newcastle attack 7th and defence 17th, Everton attack 15th and defence 6th. Understat was unreachable through the proxy, so I have no per-match xG.
checks.h2h: Everton won the cup tie 3-1 on 29 Oct (Garner, Hackney and Barry; Burn scored in the 88th minute). Newcastle won 4-1 at Everton in Nov 2025. Everton won 3-2 at St James' Park in Feb 2026. Everton have won 3 of the last 4 meetings, and none of those 4 ended level. Both sides play low-event football with Everton's defence strong, and Onside's single most likely score is 1-1 (14%).

games.reason: The market says 0.44 / 0.27 / 0.29. I raise the draw 2 points and cut Newcastle 2 points. The reasons: Everton have drawn 4 of 8 league games, including 3 of 4 away. Their defence ranks 6th on xG (Onside). Newcastle's home record is mixed (1W 2D 1L, including a 0-1 loss to Villa), and Onside has Newcastle at only 41% with 1-1 as its most likely score. Exclude anyway, for three reasons. (1) Polymarket moved about 10% relative toward Newcastle in 24 hours, from 0.405 to 0.445, with Everton down 9%, and I found no news on 1-2 Nov to explain it. (2) Reports on likely starters conflict or leave them in doubt: Grealish (disciplinary; out per Rotowire, doubtful but in the XI per starting11, and Moyes won't say) and Branthwaite (75%, concussion). (3) Everton beat this same Newcastle side 3-1 four days ago and have won 3 of the last 4 meetings.
games.main_risk: A draw or a 1-1 late equaliser. Everton under Moyes sit deep and have drawn 3 of 4 away games, their defence ranks 6th on xG, and they beat Newcastle comfortably on Thursday. Newcastle's attack depends on crosses to Wissa, and he had 7 shots with none on target against Villa.

checks.team_news: Sassuolo: Thorstvedt suspended (straight red v Lazio). Out: I. Koné (broken tibia/fibula, back December), Leysen (ACL), Boloca (knee), Paz (knee, per Sports Mole). checks.lineups: 4 sources. Fiorentina: Fantacalcio (31/10), FirenzeViola (2/11) and Sports Mole all have Thursday's XI unchanged: De Gea; Jiménez, Dragusin, Viery, João Mário; Ndour, Fagioli, Brescianini; Mastantuono, Pellegrino, Njie.
